XunitTest.GenericDefaultTest.ReplicaPayloadsTakeTheInstantiatedAcquisition(name: \"CallableForwarded\", source: \"group Helpers\\n    public func evaluate<T, F>(sample: T, factory: ref/F, marker: T = factory()) -> T\\n        F is Callable<() -> T>\\n        return marker@move\\nfunc outer<G>(g: ref/G) -> i32\\n    G is Callable<() -> i32>\\n    return Helpers.evaluate(0, g)\\nlet f = func [] () -> i32 => 7\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"\\\\(outer(f@ref))\\\")\", stdout: \"7\\n\")

XunitTest.GenericDefaultTest.ReplicaPayloadsTakeTheInstantiatedAcquisition(name: \"CallablePayload\", source: \"group Helpers\\n    public func evaluate<T, F>(sample: T, factory: ref/F, marker: i32 = label result: do\\n        let pending: Option<T> = .Some(factory())\\n        match pending@move\\n            .Some(_) => exit to result 1\\n            .None => exit to result 0\\n    ) -> i32\\n        F is Callable<() -> T>\\n            effect confined\\n        return marker\\ncontract Runner\\n    func run(self: ref/Self) -> i32\\n        effect confined\\nstruct Worker\\n    Self is Runner\\n    public func run(self: ref/Self) -> i32\\n        let factory = func [] () -> i32 => 7\\n        return Helpers.evaluate(0, factory@ref)\\nlet w = Worker.init()\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"\\\\(w.run())\\\")\", stdout: \"1\\n\")

XunitTest.GenericDefaultTest.ReplicaPayloadsTakeTheInstantiatedAcquisition(name: \"Copy\", source: \"contract Maker\\n    func make() -> Self\\nstruct Box\\n    Self is Maker\\n    public var n: i32\\n    public init(n: i32) => self.n = n\\n    public func make() -> Self => Box.init(5)\\n    drop => Console.writeLine(\\\"drop\\\")\\nstruct Pt\\n    Self is Copy and Maker\\n    public var n: i32\\n    public init(n: i32) => self.n = n\\n    public func make() -> Self => Pt.init(7)\\ngroup Helpers\\n    public func evaluate<T>(sample: T, marker: i32 = label result: do\\n        let pending: Option<T> = .Some(T.make())\\n        match pending@move\\n            .Some(let value) => exit to result 1\\n            .None => exit to result 0\\n    ) -> i32\\n        T is Maker\\n        return marker\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"\\\\(Helpers.evaluate(Pt.init(2)))\\\")\", stdout: \"1\\n\")

XunitTest.GenericDefaultTest.ReplicaPayloadsTakeTheInstantiatedAcquisition(name: \"Empty\", source: \"group Helpers\\n    public func evaluate<T>(sample: T, marker: i32 = label result: do\\n        let pending: Option<T> = .None\\n        match pending@move\\n            .Some(let value) => exit to result 1\\n            .None => exit to result 0\\n    ) -> i32\\n        return marker\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"\\\\(Helpers.evaluate(5) + Helpers.evaluate(\\\"s\\\"))\\\")\", stdout: \"0\\n\")

XunitTest.GenericDefaultTest.ReplicaPayloadsTakeTheInstantiatedAcquisition(name: \"Forwarded\", source: \"contract Maker\\n    func make() -> Self\\nstruct Box\\n    Self is Maker\\n    public var n: i32\\n    public init(n: i32) => self.n = n\\n    public func make() -> Self => Box.init(5)\\n    drop => Console.writeLine(\\\"drop\\\")\\nstruct Pt\\n    Self is Copy and Maker\\n    public var n: i32\\n    public init(n: i32) => self.n = n\\n    public func make() -> Self => Pt.init(7)\\ngroup Helpers\\n    public func evaluate<T>(sample: T, marker: i32 = label result: do\\n        let pending: Option<T> = .Some(T.make())\\n        match pending@move\\n            .Some(let value) => exit to result 1\\n            .None => exit to result 0\\n    ) -> i32\\n        T is Maker\\n        return marker\\nfunc forward<U>(value: U) -> i32\\n    U is Maker\\n    return Helpers.evaluate(value@move)\\nfunc copied<U>(value: U) -> i32\\n    U is Copy and Maker\\n    return Helpers.evaluate(value)\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"\\\\(forward(Box.init(1)) + forward(Pt.init(2)) + copied(Pt.init(3)))\\\")\", stdout: \"drop\\ndrop\\n3\\n\")

XunitTest.GenericDefaultTest.ReplicaPayloadsTakeTheInstantiatedAcquisition(name: \"PartialMove\", source: \"contract Maker\\n    func make() -> Self\\nstruct Box\\n    Self is Maker\\n    public var n: i32\\n    public init(n: i32) => self.n = n\\n    public func make() -> Self => Box.init(5)\\n    drop => Console.writeLine(\\\"drop\\\")\\nstruct Pt\\n    Self is Copy and Maker\\n    public var n: i32\\n    public init(n: i32) => self.n = n\\n    public func make() -> Self => Pt.init(7)\\ngroup Helpers\\n    public func evaluate<T>(sample: T, marker: i32 = label result: do\\n        let pair: (Option<T>, string) = (.Some(T.make()), \\\"s\\\")\\n        let first = pair.0@move\\n        Console.writeLine(pair.1)\\n        exit to result 1\\n    ) -> i32\\n        T is Maker\\n        return marker\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"\\\\(Helpers.evaluate(Box.init(1)) + Helpers.evaluate(Pt.init(2)))\\\")\", stdout: \"s\\ndrop\\ndrop\\ns\\n2\\n\")
